verdict.rationale: PagerDuty claims 750+ platform integrations and documents the Events API v2 for ingesting events from monitoring tools and observability platforms. Of the named stack, only Sentry is explicitly evidenced, and that is an SRE Agent connector for retrieving log data rather than an alert-ingestion integration. Missing for 10: named first-party integrations for Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus and CloudWatch; documented setup guides for any of the named tools; independent or hands-on corroboration of integration quality.
